FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 460
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/29/2024
House Bill 460 as introduced would prohibit certain state governmental entities from
purchasing or acquiring any real property effective June 1, 2024.
This bill could also increase the year-end balance of the State General Fund (SGF) for Fiscal
year 2024 by an estimated $75,000 by requiring the unencumbered and unexpended balances of
the Funeral Board Property Acquisition Fund and the Home Builders Property Acquisition Fund
to revert to the SGF. As of April 1, 2024, the unencumbered and unexpended balances of these
funds were $60,715.45 and $14,722.89, respectively.
